statements.impact_statement: setuptools 82.0.1 is not installed. It is a seed wheel embedded in virtualenv (pre-commit's dependency, under virtualenv/seed/wheels/embed) and only used for Python 3.9 environments, which the image does not provide. The issue also needs a macOS APFS/HFS+ filesystem, not the image's Linux one. Drop this statement once pre-commit's virtualenv no longer embeds it.
